text_en: O give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his steadfast love endures forever!
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 请你们向上主赞颂， 因为他是美善宽仁， 他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: Let Israel say, “His steadfast love endures forever. ”
text_cn: 愿以色列家赞美说： 他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: Let the house of Aaron say, “His steadfast love endures forever. ”
text_cn: 愿亚郎的家赞美说： 他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: Let those who fear the Lord say, “His steadfast love endures forever. ”
text_cn: 愿敬畏主者赞美说： 他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: Out of my distress I called on the Lord ; the Lord answered me and set me in a broad place.
text_cn: 我在急难中呼求上主， 他即垂允我，将我救出。

text_en: With the Lord on my side I do not fear. What can mortals do to me?
text_cn: 上主偕同我，我不怕什么， 世人对待我，究竟能如何？

text_en: The Lord is on my side to help me; I shall look in triumph on those who hate me.
text_cn: 上主偕同我，作我的助佑， 我必看见我的仇人受辱。

text_en: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to put confidence in mortals.
text_cn: 投奔到上主的怀抱， 远远胜过信赖同伙。

text_en: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.
text_cn: 投奔到上主的怀抱， 远远胜过信赖官僚。

text_en: All nations surrounded me; in the name of the Lord I cut them off!
text_cn: 万民虽然齐来将我围困， 奉上主名我将他们灭尽。

text_en: They surrounded me, surrounded me on every side; in the name of the Lord I cut them off!
text_cn: 他们从各处来将我围困， 奉上主名我将他们灭尽。

text_en: They surrounded me like bees; they blazed like a fire of thorns; in the name of the Lord I cut them off!
text_cn: 虽然如同黄蜂将我围困， 又好像烈火把荆棘烧焚， 奉上主名我将他们灭尽。

text_en: I was pushed hard, so that I was falling, but the Lord helped me.
text_cn: 人虽推撞我，叫我跌倒， 然而上主却扶持了我。

text_en: The Lord is my strength and my might; he has become my salvation.
text_cn: 上主是我的力量与勇敢， 他也始终作了我的救援。

text_en: There are glad songs of victory in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the Lord does valiantly;
text_cn: 在义人居住的帐幕中， 响起了胜利的欢呼声： 上主的右手大显威能，

text_en: the right hand of the Lord is exalted; the right hand of the Lord does valiantly. ”
text_cn: 上主的右手将我举擎， 上主的右手大显威能。

text_en: I shall not die, but I shall live, and recount the deeds of the Lord .
text_cn: 我不至于死，必要生存， 我要宣扬上主的工程。

text_en: The Lord has punished me severely, but he did not give me over to death.
text_cn: 上主惩罚我虽严厉非常， 但却没有把我交于死亡。

text_en: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter through them and give thanks to the Lord .
text_cn: 请给我敞开正义的门， 我要进去向上主谢恩；

text_en: This is the gate of the Lord ; the righteous shall enter through it.
text_cn: 正义的门就是上主的门， 惟独义人才能进入此门。

text_en: I thank you that you have answered me and have become my salvation.
text_cn: 我感谢你，因为你应允了我， 你也将你的救恩赐给了我。

text_en: The stone that the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone.
text_cn: 匠人弃而不用的废石， 反而成了屋角的基石；

text_en: This is the Lord ’s doing; it is marvelous in our eyes.
text_cn: 那是上主的所行所为， 在我们眼中神妙莫测。

text_en: This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
text_cn: 这是上主所安排的一天， 我们应该为此鼓舞喜欢。

text_en: Save us, we beseech you, O Lord ! O Lord , we beseech you, give us success!
text_cn: 上主！我们求你救助， 上主！我们求你赐福。

text_en: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord . We bless you from the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 奉上主之名而来的应该受赞颂， 我们要由上主的殿内祝福你们。

text_en: The Lord is God, and he has given us light. Bind the festal procession with branches, up to the horns of the altar.
text_cn: 天主是上主，他给我们光明； 隆重列队向祭坛角前进行。

text_en: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you; you are my God, I will extol you.
text_cn: 你是我的天主，我感谢你， 我的天主，我高声颂扬你。

text_en: O give thanks to the Lord , for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 请你们向上主赞颂， 因为他是美善宽仁， 他的仁慈永远常存。
